ABOUT

Data should make decisions clearer.

I am a Data Analyst, Project Lead, and researcher working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning, business analytics, and project management.

My work focuses on financial risk modeling, dynamic pricing, demand forecasting, transparent AI, and data-driven decision-making. I enjoy solving complex business and operational problems by connecting technology with practical strategy.

I earned a Master of Science in IT Project Management & Business Analytics with a 4.00/4.00 CGPA from Washington University of Science and Technology.
